opening.argument: The speaker actively promotes a new project and ties its benefit to obtaining a top ID and joining from the first day: "I am going to recommend you a new project" and "you can take the benefit of this by applying your top ID from the day 1." Viewers are then directed to contact someone, obtain an ID, gather project details, and begin: "go and text him what is MGC coin, I have to get ID, take all the details about it and start up." The on-screen instruction "Take Action" reinforces that this is a participation appeal, presenting early placement in a project hierarchy as the route to benefit rather than offering neutral analysis.
